static_traits.name: Chen Jun
static_traits.social_status: 有几个亲密朋友可谈心，但尚not yet向他们讨论自己的not足感与自我批评
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；此前not yet接受相关心理治疗或咨询
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，配合度Good，Neutral attitude；能具体描述挫折情境与自动化思维

basic_info.main_problem: 我在without法达到自己期望（如在冲浪时）的情境下，长期挣扎于自我not足与自我批评，这些感受最近更为明显，并影响我的自尊与对活动的享受。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because self-critical thoughts are affecting my self-esteem and overall well-being, making it harder for me to enjoy activities such as surfing.
growth_experiences: 过去在其他事情上not yet达到自我期望时也反复出现自我批评与not足感；这种模式已存在一段时间但近期更为突出；not yet曾接受过治疗；without重大躯体病史。

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not达到自己设定的表现标准，就说明I am not good enough、是个失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Proves oneself can do well by practicing doubly and accepting coach guidance

special_situations.event: Fell while surfing in front of everyone last weekend
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果当众失败，do not人就会看not起我、认为我是笑话
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids discussing feelings with friends, worrying about being seen as complaining or exaggerating
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone thinks I am a joke

special_situations.event: When reviewing performance after practice, although occasionally able to stay on the board longer, feels these successes are completely overshadowed by failures
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有持续且显著的进步才算数，零碎的小成功not值得被认可
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continuing to focus on practice and technical improvement, while less actively recording or affirming small progress

special_situations.event: 多次练习与接受教练指导后，仍觉得提升not明显
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果一段时间not达到Anticipation，就意味着我以后也not会变好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Has thoughts of giving up or uses self-criticism to push oneself to keep practicing

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as capable, achieve in surfing, and enjoy it
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败被他人视为笑话、害怕被评价为“戏剧化”，从而暴露自己的not够好
defense_goal: Maintains high standards through harsh self-criticism to avoid failure
Avoiding revealing vulnerability to friends to reduce the risk of being judged

object_relations.object_representation: Bystanders who will judge oneself and see oneself as a joke or an exaggeration

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师询问是否与朋友讨论not足感及可能的反应时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者潜意识认为朋友会觉得他在抱怨或夸张（移情：将评价Projection到他人）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Cautious tone, emphasizes 'they might think I am exaggerating', avoiding deeper discussion of the possibility of support and concrete plans.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When exploring the specific situations of surfing failure and progress
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Turns external frustration toward self-deprecation, maintaining a sense of control and 'motivation' through self-criticism
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use自我贬低的表述（如“I am not good enough”），语气低落，忽略正面细节与小幅进步。

manifestations: not愿与朋友讨论自己的not足感与自我批评
Worrying others will think one is 'being dramatic' or complaining
The fun in activities is swallowed up by self-criticism and feelings of failure

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 'They might think I am being dramatic'

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 频繁自我批评（“I am not good enough”“I will never get better”）
In sessions, cautious about sharing feelings and seeking support

exception_events.target_problem: 在冲浪练习中遇到摔倒或without法起板时，来访者通常会陷入“I am not good enough”的自我批评，Low mood并难以享受当日训练。
exception_events.unique_outcome: In the last few practices, there were moments of standing on the board longer and completing steadier rides than before.
exception_events.reason: not同做法：持续练习并接受教练指导，使skill逐步提升，从而出现更长时间站板的时刻。

positive_force: Committed and passionate about surfing; can practice persistently
Has some external resources (coach guidance and practice conditions)
Has several close friends who can provide support
negative_force: 自我批评强烈、常use消极标签
Negative cognitive patterns such as mental filtering and mind reading are prominent
Worry about others' evaluations leads to avoiding seeking support
Progress standards too strict; dismisses small successes

target_behavior.behavior: 在挫折后出现强烈的自我贬低与消极自我标签（如“I am useless冲浪者”）
antecedent: 面对挑战性任务且短期进步not明显
not yet达到自我期望的表现
target_behavior.core_reason: 长期存在的“I am not good enough”核心信念与对失败的非黑即白/过度概括解读在挑战情境中被激活。
target_behavior.function: 短期通过自我批评来维持控制感或自我驱动，同时回避向他人求助以减少被评判的Anxiety。
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased self-esteem、Increased stress、难以享受冲浪与日常活动，持续削弱动力与幸福感。
